candidate.title: RRBS / scRRBS
candidate.scope: The assigned poster’s grouped RRBS/scRRBS row: reduced representation bisulfite sequencing (also labelled RRBS-Seq) and single-cell RRBS. Extract the shared, unbranched MspI → end repair/ligation of methylated adapters → bisulfite → PCR library architecture. RRBS is anchored to the cited Meissner 2008 implementation; scRRBS applicability is supported at shared schematic level by the Guo 2015 abstract, which describes modification of RRBS and single-tube integration before PCR. This does not establish identical complete protocols. Neighboring PBAT, BSPP and BSAS rows and the partial chemical legend at right are contextual and have no material connections to this row. The yellow-highlighted overview thumbnail is descriptive. No separate selection, pooling, single-cell isolation or sequencing operation is drawn.

operations.label: MspI digestion
operations.description: Digest genomic DNA into short restriction fragments. Preserve the figure caption “Methylated regions” while interpreting the product as MspI fragments rather than a selection for methylation.
operations.mechanism: MspI is identified by the RRBS primary paper as a methylation-insensitive restriction enzyme.
operations.information_effect: Digestion defines the genomic restriction-fragment boundaries; methylation does not determine whether a locus is cut. The represented subset depends on which fragments enter the library. The RRBS paper also reports fragment-size selection, which the diagram leaves implicit and which is not added as a drawn operation or assigned to scRRBS.

operations.label: End repair and ligation
operations.description: Modify the MspI fragment ends and covalently attach the supplied methylated adapters, converting genomic fragments into adapter-ended DNA. Keep this as the combined block drawn in the figure.
operations.mechanism: The cited RRBS implementation fills in and 3′-A-extends MspI fragments, then ligates pre-annealed methylated adapters. This clarifies the drawn end-repair/ligation interface without adding an independent unshown operation.
operations.information_effect: Known adapter sequences are joined to genomic fragment ends before conversion, providing the downstream library interface. Interpretation: methylation helps preserve adapter sequence usability through conversion for subsequent PCR; exact adapter sequence is not specified.
